    assign eq = ~x;
    assign ga = a & b;
    assign gab = (~a) & b;

        .p(x), .g(ga), .carry(ca)

    );

        .p(eq), .g(gba), .carry(cba)
    );

    assign add_result = x ^ ca;
    assign ab_result = x ^ cab;
    assign ba_result = x ^ cba;

    always @* begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = add_result;
            3'b001: sum = ab_result;
            3'b010: sum = ba_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = x;
            3'b110: sum = eq;
            default: sum = {WIDTH{1'b0}};
        endcase
    end
endmodule

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] px, pe;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ga, gab, gba;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ca, cab, cba;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ra, rab, rba;
    wire [6:0] sel;

    assign px = a ^ b;
    assign pe = ~px;
    assign ga = a & b;
    assign gab = (~a) & b;
    assign gba = a & (~b);

    pw_alu_block_carry #(.N(WIDTH)) add_carry (
        .p(px), .g(ga), .c(ca)
    );
    pw_alu_block_carry #(.N(WIDTH)) ab_borrow (
        .p(pe), .g(gab), .c(cab)
    );
    pw_alu_block_carry #(.N(WIDTH)) ba_borrow (
        .p(pe), .g(gba), .c(cba)
    );

    assign ra = px ^ ca;
    assign rab = px ^ cab;
    assign rba = px ^ cba;

    assign sel[0] = (Oper == 3'b000);
    assign sel[1] = (Oper == 3'b001);
    assign sel[2] = (Oper == 3'b010);
    assign sel[3] = (Oper == 3'b011);
    assign sel[4] = (Oper == 3'b100);
    assign sel[5] = (Oper == 3'b101);
    assign sel[6] = (Oper == 3'b110);

    always @* begin
        sum = ({WIDTH{sel[0]}} & ra)
            | ({WIDTH{sel[1]}} & rab)
            | ({WIDTH{sel[2]}} & rba)
            | ({WIDTH{sel[3]}} & (a | b))
            | ({WIDTH{sel[4]}} & ga)
            | ({WIDTH{sel[5]}} & px)
            | ({WIDTH{sel[6]}} & pe);
    end
endmodule

module pw_alu_block_carry #(
    parameter N = 64
)(
    input wire [N-1:0] p,
    input wire [N-1:0] g,
    output wire [N-1:0] c
);
    localparam NB = (N + 3) / 4;
    wire [NB-1:0] gp, gg;
    wire [NB-1:0] bc;

    genvar j, t, r, k;
    generate
        for (j = 0; j < NB; j = j + 1) begin: blocks
            localparam BASE = 4*j;
            localparam L = ((N-BASE) >= 4) ? 4 : (N-BASE);
            wire [L-1:0] gt;
            assign gp[j] = &p[BASE+L-1:BASE];
            for (t = 0; t < L; t = t + 1) begin: group_terms
                if (t == L-1) begin: last
                    assign gt[t] = g[BASE+t];
                end else begin: earlier
                    assign gt[t] = g[BASE+t] & (&p[BASE+L-1:BASE+t+1]);
                end
            end
            assign gg[j] = |gt;

            if (j == 0) begin: first_block
                assign bc[j] = 1'b0;
            end else begin: later_block
                wire [j-1:0] bt;
                for (t = 0; t < j; t = t + 1) begin: boundary_terms
                    if (t == j-1) begin: adjacent
                        assign bt[t] = gg[t];
                    end else begin: distant
                        assign bt[t] = gg[t] & (&gp[j-1:t+1]);
                    end
                end
                assign bc[j] = |bt;
            end

            assign c[BASE] = bc[j];
            for (r = 1; r < L; r = r + 1) begin: internal_carries
                wire [r:0] ct;
                assign ct[r] = bc[j] & (&p[BASE+r-1:BASE]);
                for (k = 0; k < r; k = k + 1) begin: internal_terms
                    if (k == r-1) begin: adjacent
                        assign ct[k] = g[BASE+k];
                    end else begin: distant
                        assign ct[k] = g[BASE+k] & (&p[BASE+r-1:BASE+k+1]);
                    end
                end
                assign c[BASE+r] = |ct;
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

  "bottleneck": "The measured critical paths run from operand bits to upper result bits through arithmetic carry/borrow resolution and final operation selection. The baseline maximum data arrival is 1.96 ns; mapped cell names alone do not identify which arithmetic operation dominates.",
  "rewrite": "Replace inferred arithmetic operators with parallel four-bit-block carry and borrow lookahead networks. Explicit sum-of-products equations resolve block boundaries without a serial block-carry chain. Share operand XOR between all arithmetic results and logical XOR, and share its complement between both borrow networks and XNOR. Select completed results using mutually exclusive operation decodes.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The bounded local lookahead and parallel block-boundary equations target a shorter operand-to-upper-result path. A roughly 10–20% arrival-time reduction is a reasonable target, not a measured result; the actual improvement requires the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Three parallel arithmetic networks trade some lookahead wiring and product terms for reduced carry depth. Shared XOR, equality propagation, and logical terms limit duplication. Compliance with the 3074.698880 um2 area cap and electrical limits remains unmeasured and must be checked in the evaluation flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the pw_alu interface, unsigned ports, WIDTH parameter with default 64, and combinational operation. At WIDTH=16, all arithmetic is modulo 2^16: 000 adds, 001 computes a-b, 010 computes b-a, 011 ORs, 100 ANDs, 101 XORs, 110 XNORs, and 111 returns zero. Carry and borrow overflow are discarded. The helper also supports other positive WIDTH values, including partial final blocks. No state, latency, assumptions, undefined outputs, or external dependencies are introduced. Equivalence is intended for arbitrary binary inputs; no CRC ports exist in this module."
